study type: Animal study (reproductive and developmental toxicity study)
cohort: The study included Sprague-Dawley female rats administered the vaccine before mating and during gestation, with their F1 offspring evaluated for prenatal and postnatal development.
finding: Vaccination with AS03-adjuvanted CoVLP induced an antibody response in F0 females and offspring, but there was no evidence of untoward effects on female fertility, reproductive performance, embryo-fetal development, or early F1 offspring development.
mod_finding: The pre/post-natal (PPN) cohort was allowed to naturally deliver, and effects were evaluated during parturition, but no specific findings related to the mode of birth were detailed beyond observing natural delivery.
followup_time: Up to weaning for F1 offspring
